Name: XNG hypervisor
Description: Type 1 hypervisor for real-time mixed-criticality embedded systems providing time and space isolation; ISOLDE work integrates NOEL-V/CVA6 support, SafeTI/SafeSU, validation tools and fault-diagnosis tests, and L2C/AHB filter partitioning on XNG.
Comment: Single IP referenced by several ISOLDE WIs (IDs 2.4.01, 3.1.11, 4.1.09, 4.3.12, 4.3.13, 2.2.08); local IP cards at ip_cards/FENTISS_ISOLDE_-_*.json. PROVISIONAL: URL taken from the card text.
